description: This file defines the OEmbedFormatter class for rendering media fields with oEmbed content in Drupal. It includes methods for rendering, configuration, and applicability checks, and references various Drupal core and media-specific services and classes.

classes.name: OEmbedFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for formatting media fields with oEmbed content, providing rendering, configuration, and applicability logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting necessary services for the formatter.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for the formatter.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for each media item, handling different resource types and security considerations.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the formatter settings.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current formatter settings.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the formatter is applicable to a given field definition based on media type and source.
